input_template: 请配置暂态稳定模型的IEEE14 发电机跳闸预测任务。主要物理参数为：V_base_kv 取 {value_0} kV；load_scale 取 {value_1}；P_load_mean 取 {value_2} MW；P_load_std 取 {value_3} MW；Q_load_ratio 取 {value_4}。补充控制参数为：P_gen_total 取 {value_5} MW；renewable_ratio 取 {value_6}；fault_duration 取 {value_7} s；grid_voltage_pu 取 {value_8} pu；n_buses 取 {value_9}。其余场景参数为：inertia_mean 取 {value_10} s；damping_mean 取 {value_11}（约为基准值的 8 倍）；line_loading 取 {value_12}；voltage_dev 取 {value_13} pu；freq_dev 取 {value_14} Hz。观测设置采用完整10秒轨迹，100Hz采样共1000个时间步，观测通道为第1号发电机、第2号发电机、第3号发电机、第4号发电机、第5号发电机（共5行中的5行）。请预测发电机转子角的时间序列。

input_template: Configure a transient prediction case for ieee14_gentrip: IEEE 14-bus permanent generator trip; system rebalances active power; tests post-trip rotor angle dynamics. The governing context is Transient stability simulation (ANDES DAE solver). IEEE 14-bus test system with 5 generators. DAE system: δ̇=ω, Mω̇=Pm−Pe−Dω, 0=g(x,y). Implicit trapezoidal integration at 100 Hz. Outputs generator rotor angles (rad) over 10 seconds following a disturbance event. Use the following parameterization: V_base_kv = {value_0} kV for base voltage of the bus system after being at 2× nominal; load scaling factor relative to base case (load_scale) takes {value_1}; P_load_mean (mean active power load per bus) is {value_2} MW; P_load_std, representing standard deviation of active power load, is set to {value_3} MW; Q_load_ratio = {value_4} for ratio of reactive to active load. Additional controls are total active power generation before disturbance (P_gen_total) takes {value_5} MW; renewable_ratio (fraction of generation from renewables (affects inertia)) is {value_6}; fault_duration, representing fault clearing time (0 for load-step scenarios, 0.05-0.25s for fault scenarios), is set to {value_7} s; grid_voltage_pu = {value_8} pu for pre-disturbance bus voltage setpoint after being offset downward by 21.55; number of buses (14 for all IEEE14 scenarios) (n_buses) takes {value_9}. Remaining physical or categorical settings are inertia_mean (mean generator inertia constant H (scales all generators)) is {value_10} s; damping_mean, representing mean generator damping coefficient D, is set to {value_11}; line_loading = {value_12} for pre-disturbance line loading factor; pre-disturbance voltage deviation (voltage_dev) takes {value_13} pu after being roughly 90.42 higher than nominal; freq_dev (pre-disturbance frequency deviation) is {value_14} Hz. Use full 10-second trajectory, 1000 time steps at 100 Hz; observed channels: generator 1, generator 2, generator 3, generator 4, generator 5 (5 of 5) and predict rotor_angles.
target_template: Model output for rotor_angles:{output_0}

input_template: Run the transient ieee14 gentrip case with V_base_kv = {value_0} kV for base voltage of the bus system; load scaling factor relative to base case (load_scale) takes {value_1}; P_load_mean (mean active power load per bus) is {value_2} MW; P_load_std, representing standard deviation of active power load, is set to {value_3} MW; Q_load_ratio = {value_4} for ratio of reactive to active load; total active power generation before disturbance (P_gen_total) takes {value_5} MW; renewable_ratio (fraction of generation from renewables (affects inertia)) is {value_6}; fault_duration, representing fault clearing time (0 for load-step scenarios, 0.05-0.25s for fault scenarios), is set to {value_7} s. Use grid_voltage_pu = {value_8} pu for pre-disturbance bus voltage setpoint; number of buses (14 for all IEEE14 scenarios) (n_buses) takes {value_9}; inertia_mean (mean generator inertia constant H (scales all generators)) is {value_10} s; damping_mean, representing mean generator damping coefficient D, is set to {value_11}; line_loading = {value_12} for pre-disturbance line loading factor; pre-disturbance voltage deviation (voltage_dev) takes {value_13} pu; freq_dev (pre-disturbance frequency deviation) is {value_14} Hz after being approximately 4× the baseline value. With full 10-second trajectory, 1000 time steps at 100 Hz; observed channels: generator 1, generator 2, generator 3, generator 4, generator 5 (5 of 5), predict rotor_angles.
target_template: Model output for rotor_angles:{output_0}
